classification.A: ADR131 NR-04 原生文件能力与有界扫描 registered before implementation: native limits/errors contract and owned file-I/O task/control seam under ADR130. Existing permission, Evidence, storage and unknown-reconciliation policy remains in force.
classification.B: Migrate current five file manifests and aliases under ADR49/92/101/129/131; same-boundary fixes for canonical workspace display, semantic tool failures and partial creation outcome. Qoder labelled-frame/catalog follow-up is included in this combined source.

change.chain: Provider -> same manifests -> Runtime Projection -> Tool Call -> existing live Grant -> file I/O -> canonical result/Evidence. Required-capability admission uses actual built-in provider manifests rather than a separate central list.
change.ownership: Each operation is one awaited spawn_blocking task. Bounded EffectAdmission Check asks the actual Host for current policy/Goal/lease/input authority before I/O and writes; cancellation is observed without starving heartbeat. The real worker is awaited, not abandoned on cancellation.
change.fidelity: Locale-aware directory sort and search casing use pinned ICU4X; final search full-path order uses UTF-16. Skip .git/node_modules and non-regular child entries, preserve CRLF/final-CR semantics, invalid UTF-8 replacement for search, result limits and truncated flags. Exact edit retains read hashes, ambiguity/missing/conflict errors and current TS single-replacement dollar tokens.

limits.onPressure: Fail explicitly without publishing a partial success; preserve effects/history/Evidence and unknown dispatches.

baseline.description: Retained featureless predecessor bcd candidate refuses list_files at the real public CLI with tool_not_projected; synthetic failed fixture retained.

actualTs.scope: Actual compiled TS FileProvider over synthetic files and actual Node Intl locale observations. Separate from Host authorization and real-model evidence.

firstHost.reason: Canonical target /private/var vs lexical workspace /var produced an incorrect relative path; whitespace query incorrectly aborted the episode instead of a structured tool failure. Original assertions retained; canonicalize workspace namespace and defer semantic validation to Provider outcome.

partialCreate.reason: Real filesystem CREATE followed by a denied control check left an empty file but reported only permission_policy_changed. Original test fails before correction, then passes with execution_outcome_unknown and empty file preserved. This is an actual EffectAdmission/FS module test with an authority seam; not a dedicated public-CLI partial-create race reproduction.

clippy.reason: Cargo auto-discovered new flat helper modules as standalone test targets; moved helpers into module directories. Replaced constant chunks_exact with MSRV-compatible as_chunks; no assertions or warning gates weakened.

interruption.reason: Review found accepted native scan limits/errors were recorded in ADR and real Host tests but not yet registered as a language-neutral protocol resource. Stop this owned pre-Host gate to add the missing contract before final validation. Not a passing or failed test gate.

interruptedGate.scope: Stopped owned group during pre-Host clippy to register the missing language-neutral native limit contract; not a passing or failing test gate. Final validation uses a fresh output root.

validation.newHostCoverage: Seven new tests: real list->search->read->edit->read with Grant/Evidence;12 actual TS cases/34 operations;16,385 entries and FIFO/result pressure; failed read cannot grant edit snapshot; actual edit denial; paused real worker heartbeat then policy/content changes; signal drain/later task; post-edit hard exit/unknown recovery without replay. Worker barrier is fixture-only; the final featureless suite excludes those fault-only controls explicitly.

existingStateRecovery: No personal records inspected or modified. Snapshot state is ephemeral and never permission truth. Failed/denied operations preserve source files. Existing pending dispatch/unknown and known fees/Evidence survive cancellation or hard exit; restart/recover does not replay edits. A new explicit task may run while original unknown effects stay blocked by existing scope/claim policy. Empty post-CREATE outcomes are not deleted to manufacture no-effect recovery.
